thread:
Bea: Heads-up — noticed weird mismatch on the cost dashboard this morning. Route /api/complete shows high warm_hit counts but the per-model cost card shows zero cache credits for a ~90s slice.
Omar: Which model? Which exact card?
Bea: Model: redwood-lite. Panel = per-model unit-econ (10m window). Raw token_events show warm hits, reconciled credits = 0 for the interval.
Jin: Could be the new "lineage-collapse" change we rolled. If lineage owner resolution returns empty for a short time, reconciler may drop emission.
ops-bot: deploy 5100009950 - lineage-service v4.0 -> v4.1 (flag: lineage_collapse=true).
Luc: UX: users panic when the unit-econ card goes to 0. Suggest adding a small "data-warning" chip on the card when reconciler flags or sampling are active, plus an inline link to explain provisional credits.
Bea: I ran a quick aggregate:
```
SELECT sum(warm_tokens) as warm, sum(credited_tokens) as credits
FROM token_events
WHERE ts BETWEEN 5100009400 AND 5100010040
AND route = '/api/complete';
```
Result: warm=14,200, credits=0.
Jin: Short-term mitigation: (1) roll back lineage_collapse for prod, (2) emit provisional credited rows when owner=null with credited_provisional=true and reconciler_version tag. That keeps the dashboard honest.
Omar: Agree. Also add an alert: if warm_hits > 2k/min and credited_tokens == 0 for > 30s, page eng-platform.
ops-bot: rollback 5100010010 - lineage-service v4.1 -> v4.0 (auto-rollback triggered).
Luc: I'll draft the UI copy for the "data-warning" chip and a tooltip that references the reconciler_version and what "provisional" means. Keep it short and link to the deeper doc.
Bea: Jin, can you implement provisional emit with a TTL and dedupe key? Omar, can you run a staging burst after to confirm raw vs reconciled parity?
Jin: Yep, will add credited_provisional + reconciler_version, TTL=5m, and a dedupe key per batch. Estimate ~90m.
Omar: Will run a 3-min staging ramp and post the diff.
Bea: Thanks all. Action items: rollback done, provisional-emits planned, alert rule request, console chip copy. Will follow up in this thread when staging test finished. :thumbsup:
